data.title: The Chalk Mark
data.text: The chalk mark on No. 14 Church Lane was a circle with a line through it. I drew it at ten past six to show the house was empty, then found there was nothing left on my list. You came through Church Lane, and No. 14 Church Lane was destroyed; the chalk could not change that. Eleven boxes of this archive stayed in the house, along with the kitchen calendar and a piano that had not been tuned since 2020. Gil Harrow wrote that Riverside put off raising the dam spillway in 2009 and 2016. He gave the inspectors, harbour dredging, the leaking school roof, and his belief that there was time as reasons. Riverside dam was destroyed. I have kept the chalk.
